question: Who alone is entitled to worship the Lord, to the exclusion of others?
premises: Some persons take refuge in the Lord alone.
The Lord states he is to be worshipped by them.
The Lord states he is not to be worshipped by others.
inference: Only those who take exclusive refuge in the Lord are entitled to worship him.
plain_english: But I am to be worshipped by those who take refuge in me alone, and not by others.
